title: A0 — Lab safety and local threat model
bodyMarkdown:
## Before you touch AWS

This workbook runs locally on **127.0.0.1**. Progress and answer keys live in **SQLite** and in **content JSON** on disk. Another process on your PC could call the Django port.

- Use a **named CLI profile** or IAM Identity Center; never root access keys.
- **$10 is a warning**, not a cap. Budget alerts lag hours and do not stop spend.
- Complete **teardown** when you finish or stop early; stopping an instance is not teardown.
- Agents and this app **never** call AWS on your behalf.


### Permissions boundary

A permissions boundary is a second IAM policy that sets the maximum permissions a user or role can have, even if another policy grants more. GL-01 creates one so lab principals cannot exceed the lab deny list.
